task_description: Implement ADX Milestone 2 across all six phases from the approved design (.agents/tasks/m2-design.md): real data binding with a sandboxed setup(); JSON page manifests compiling to one crawlable index.html per page; component composition with per-instance hydration identity, slot projection, and CSS isolation; an explicit no-vDOM reactivity patch contract with computed-backed freezing; a measured gpt-tokenizer benchmark; and documentation sync. Keep all 77 M1 tests green and the SEO static-first contract intact.
